device.description: 16-bit 500 kSPS fully differential SAR ADC with integrated reference buffer and LDO, enhanced-SPI interface (ADS8922B)
device.note: ads8922b.pdf (SBAS729C) p.3-4 pin functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.9-10 timing requirements and switching characteristics, p.24 transfer function (twos complement), p.28 commands, p.28-30 output data word and parity, p.31-32 data transfer frame, p.39 SPI protocols, p.52-57 register map

registers.name: PATN_LSB
registers.note: p.54-55 PATN registers, Figure 7-8 (DATA_PATN[15:0] = PATN_MSB[3:0], PATN_MID[7:0], PATN_LSB[7:4])

registers.name: PATN_MID
registers.note: p.54-55 PATN registers, Figure 7-8 (DATA_PATN[15:0] = PATN_MSB[3:0], PATN_MID[7:0], PATN_LSB[7:4])

registers.name: PATN_MSB
registers.note: p.54-55 PATN registers, Figure 7-8 (DATA_PATN[15:0] = PATN_MSB[3:0], PATN_MID[7:0], PATN_LSB[7:4])

commands.name: WR_REG (PD_CNTL, PD_ADC = 1)
commands.note: p.28 Table 6-2; PD_CNTL: setting PD_ADC powers the converter down at the CS rising edge

commands.name: WR_REG (PD_CNTL, PD_ADC = 0)
commands.note: p.28 Table 6-2; PD_CNTL: clearing PD_ADC powers the converter up

commands.name: RD_REG
commands.note: p.28 Table 6-2; p.28-30 output data word, Figure 6-12: D[21:14] of the next frame are the register, D[13:0] zeros

pages: p.3-4 (pins), p.5 (ROC: DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9-10 (timing), p.24 (transfer function), p.28-30 (commands, output data word), p.31-32 (frame), p.39 (SPI protocols), p.52-57 (registers)
notModeled: analog input, reference input, reference buffer and LDO; the result is always the 0 V differential code 0000h (twos complement)
22-bit command word decoded from the last 22 SDI bits before CS rises (align end); frames shorter than 22 SCLKs are NOPs (p.31-32 data transfer frame)

SPI protocol selection: SDI_MODE (SPI-01/10/11) and SDO_MODE early data launch / source-synchronous output, SDO_WIDTH dual/quad SDO, DATA_RATE (DDR), SSYNC_CLK_SEL with RVS as strobe: stored only; the bus stays SPI-00-S on SDO-0 (SDO-1..3 never driven)
parity bits FLPAR/FTPAR (PAR_EN, FPAR_LOC): stored only; the parity positions output 0, which is correct for the 0 V code but not for register read-back or nonzero test patterns

PD_ADC power-down is modeled only for WR_REG to PD_CNTL (SET_BITS/CLR_BITS on PD_CNTL change the bit without powering down); PD_REFBUF, power-up times tPU_ADC / tPU_REFBUF, RST-to-RVS delay td_rst 3 ms
RVS while CS is low (low from CS fall, then per output protocol) and the td_CSRDY_r delay after CS rise: not modeled; RVS is low while converting
offset calibration (REF_SEL) and reference margining (EN_MARG, REF_OFST): stored only
conversion time varies 1100-1200 ns (modeled: tconv max 1200 ns); cycle time, acquisition and quiet-zone timing, SCLK frequency limits
reserved command codes: treated as NOP (unmatched)
variants: ads8922b.pdf covers ADS8920B (1 MSPS, tconv 640 ns), ADS8922B (500 kSPS, 1200 ns) and ADS8924B (250 kSPS, 2500 ns): same pinout, registers and protocol; only the conversion time differs.
